summary: LLMville 3D Builder dev API. Remote agents use HTTP only — no repository access required.
firstStep: GET /__llmville-builder/status, then POST /__llmville-builder/assets to create an object

agentRules.context: External agent with HTTP access only. Do not open or edit the LLMville source repository.
do: POST /__llmville-builder/assets to create and save primitive/group objects
doNot: Do not create scripts or files in the repo
Do not trust stale screenshot PNGs without a fresh requestId
Do not rely on catalog modelKey for new objects — many are placeholder GLBs

screenshots.prerequisite: Browser tab at /dev/build must be open (check GET /status browserConnected).
